focus: plugin inventory, specific and generic router correctness, and target review inputs

findingDetails.title: Spec-folder target lacks normative review inputs
findingDetails.claim: A spec-folder review target lacks the normative inputs needed to validate scope and acceptance evidence.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the target root inventory and the existing report for an alternate normative packet or checklist.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The packet may intentionally be a report-only review artifact rather than an implementation spec.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A scoped spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md/checklist.md set or an explicit non-spec target contract is added.

findingDetails.title: Generic plugin route loads a partial reference set
findingDetails.claim: The generic PLUGINS route returns a partial plugin reference set despite the skill promising eleven plugin/theme surfaces.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked every specific PLUGIN_* intent and confirmed that all eleven have dedicated resource maps.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The generic route may intentionally provide only a starter subset and rely on follow-up disambiguation, but the code does not declare that limitation.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: The generic route is documented as intentionally partial with an explicit disambiguation/expansion contract, or it loads all eleven reference sets.

findingDetails.title: Human resource-loading index omits newer plugin references
findingDetails.claim: The human-facing resource-loading index omits six plugin/theme reference sets that the executable router supports.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the executable RESOURCE_MAP and all eleven plugin reference directories.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The section may be intentionally abbreviated, but it is not labeled as an abbreviated index.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: The section is labeled as a partial example and links to the complete router/resource inventory.
